2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona’s protection and secondary depth face Herbert’s rebuilt Chargers attack
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona reaches SoFi short-handed in the secondary and interior line, with Garrett Williams, Dadrion Taylor-Demerson and Isaiah Adams ruled out while Jeremiyah Love is questionable. The Cardinals still have a focal-point matchup weapon in Trey McBride, but must keep their offense out of obvious passing downs. Los Angeles opens Mike McDaniel’s offense around Justin Herbert behind a healthy tackle pair and rookie center Jake Slaughter. Arizona’s pressure plan, Chargers protection and explosive-play prevention are the clearest swing points.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles has the cleaner path if Herbert is protected, while Arizona’s upset route depends on disrupting the new interior combination and sustaining efficient offense through McBride.
